x_failures: Says Monconys 'was shown... a perpetual motion machine' and that Kuffler 'preserved' it, but p.50 says these secrets 'were lost with his death'. Merges the bread oven with the separate self-regulating furnace ('This was the famous Drebbelian Athanor, which used a thermostat'). Claims, without support from the Egyptian-ovens page, that Kuffler was 'attempting to commercialize' that technology.
reason: Y quotes Monconys's first-hand account of the oven he saw (p.51), correctly notes that Oldenburg came with him and adds the distillation furnace, and its claims match the pages. X wrongly says Monconys was shown inventions the page calls lost, and it confuses the two furnaces.
